invariants: The latest GitHub main branch is the code source of truth
Never expose or commit secret values
Never delete catalog data because of a transient network or marketplace failure
Public search uses search-index.json instead of querying all Firestore products
Price availability checking runs as one manual daily batch unless force is explicit
The price batch uses the official items/bulk endpoint with at most 20 item IDs per request
The price batch reads Firestore once, reuses mercadolivre-status.json and mlb-resolucoes.json, and leaves deep item discovery to the locator workflow
The price batch uses at most two concurrent workers, spaces marketplace requests, retries 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff and jitter, and refreshes a rejected OAuth session at most once
Transient marketplace failures preserve the last confirmed price and never trigger individual sale-price or promotion requests for every product
top5-semanal.json contains exactly six distinct valid products despite its legacy filename
Weekly comparison contains exactly five comparable products and requires human approval
Shopee reuses the existing product record and does not duplicate catalog data
Generated pages, sitemap, analysis directory and search index must agree
Prices must never render as NaN
Ranki videos are kept in browser memory or YouTube, never Firebase Storage or Git
YouTube upload requires human approval and stores only the video reference on the product
The public video showcase accepts 3 to 10 YouTube and Ranking product URL pairs and never stores the video file in Firebase
The video administrator uses separate YouTube and Ranking product URL fields while preserving the existing site configuration document
Each public video has a clickable product card populated from search-index.json and synchronized with the current playlist item
The promotion title must be human-approved, descriptive and between 20 and 75 characters
AI promotion-title suggestions use only active offers already loaded by the dashboard and never trigger another full Firestore catalog read
Web-grounded title suggestions display their Google Search queries, sources and search widget and never claim popularity without evidence
AI promotion-title suggestions never save or publish automatically; a human must select, review and save the title
Architecture changes require updating both blueprint files
